claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve to fund a part-time Dolos maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The total requested withdrawal is 540,750 ADA, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Dolos maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Dolos is a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides efficient chain-data access without the overhead of traditional full nodes.
Dolos exposes five query interfaces, including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C Unix socket compatible with Cardano-cli, Ogmios, and other tooling.
The proposer states that Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.
The proposer states that Dolos achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount is claimed not to breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are described as included through Intersect administration, independent third parties, and smart-contract-based treasury management.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development on schedule.
The proposal states that TxPipe's prior Intersect-funded open-source maintenance for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC is being delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA through Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts to continue 12 months of Dolos maintenance, community support, protocol compatibility work, documentation, and AI-workflow integration resources, with cited budget-process and oversight references.
